遺伝子の配置\n階層（縦）: 制御する側が上になるよう段に並べる\n階層（横）::
Gene layout
Hierarchy (vertical): regulators placed in rows above their targets
Hierarchy (horizontal): regulators placed in columns left of their targets
Concentric: genes with more connections placed nearer the center
Grid: genes placed in a grid in layout order
遺伝子の色\n役割: SGD の機能説明から推定したキナーゼ・転写制御因子などの:
Gene color
Role: classes such as kinase or transcription regulator, inferred from SGD descriptions
\n破壊株の mRNA・リン酸化: 左の「破壊株」タブで選んだ株での、野生型との: Deletion mRNA / phosphorylation: measured log2 ratio vs. wild type in the strain chosen in the Deletions tab. The deleted gene is black. Clearing the strain selection restores the previous colors
発現・リン酸化の条件\nその種類のデータがない条件では、遺伝子はすべて灰色になり:
Condition for expression / phosphorylation
If a condition has no data of that kind, all genes are gray
破壊株の mRNA・リン酸化で色分けするときの、壊した遺伝子\nmRNA は D:
Deleted gene used when coloring by deletion mRNA / phosphorylation
mRNA: 1,481 strains from Deleteome (Kemmeren 2014); phosphorylation: 113 kinase/phosphatase strains from Bodenmiller 2010. If a strain has no measurement of that kind, all genes are gray
壊した遺伝子: 株を、壊した遺伝子の名前で絞り込みます\n変化した遺伝子: 今の:
Deleted gene: filter strains by the name of the deleted gene
Changed gene: choose a gene on the current map to list, by name, the deletion strains that changed its expression (phosphorylation). Genes changed in some strain are black; unchanged genes are gray
選んだ破壊株で変わった、今の地図の遺伝子（名前の順）。押すと右側に説明を出します: Genes on the current map changed in the chosen deletion strain (by name). Click to show details on the right
どの破壊株でも変化していません: Not changed in any deletion strain
どれかの破壊株で変化しました: Changed in at least one deletion strain
今の地図の遺伝子のうち {n} 個がこの株で変わりました: {n} genes on the current map changed in this strain
今の地図の遺伝子は、この株で変わっていません: No gene on the current map changed in this strain
{name} の破壊株の mRNA の測定はありません: No mRNA measurement for the {name} deletion
{name} の破壊株のリン酸化の測定はありません: No phosphorylation measurement for the {name} deletion
チェックした条件で大きく変化した、今の地図の遺伝子（名前の順）。値は変化の最も大: Genes on the current map that changed strongly under the checked conditions (by name). The value is from the condition with the largest change. Click to show details on the right
遺伝子の一覧と、経路の一覧（その名前を通る経路）を絞り込みます: Filters the gene list and the path list (paths through that name)
チェックした遺伝子から選びます。選ぶと、基準の遺伝子が端にある経路だけを一覧にし:
Choose from the checked genes. Only paths that start or end at the anchor gene are listed.
Required for the path modes toward / from the anchor gene
経路を調べる遺伝子をチェックします（操作中の表示枠で注目・拡張している遺伝子）: Check the genes to find paths between (Focus and Expand genes in the active map panel)
一覧の遺伝子（絞り込み中は見えているもの）をすべてチェックします: Checks all genes in the list (only visible ones while filtering)
いま経路タブで強調している遺伝子だけを新しい表示枠に描きます。一覧で経路を選んで:
Draws only the genes highlighted in the Paths tab in a new map panel. If no path is selected, draws the checked genes.
Re-layout in that panel restores the original gene set and lays it out again
経路の色\n修飾・制御: 修飾・制御の種類で色分け。リン酸化＝橙、転写制御＝青な:
Path color
Modification/regulation: colored by type (phosphorylation = orange, transcriptional regulation = blue, etc.)
Effect: activation = red, inhibition = blue, unknown effect = gray, binding = light gray
経路: チェックした条件で報告された経路を目立たせます\n遺伝子: チェックした:
Paths: highlight paths reported under the checked conditions
Genes: highlight genes whose expression or phosphorylation changed ≥ 2-fold under the checked conditions
チェックした条件に合う、今の地図の経路（名前の順）。押すと右側に経路の説明を出し: Paths on the current map matching the checked conditions (by name). Click to show path details on the right
段数がちょうどこの数の経路だけを一覧にします。1 なら直接の経路です。複合体は: Lists only paths with exactly this many steps. 1 means direct paths. A complex counts as one
経路を選ぶと地図で強調します。上流や「上流 … 行き先」の組を選ぶと、その中の経:
Select a path to highlight it on the map. Selecting an upstream gene or an "upstream … target" group highlights all paths in it.
Symbols: → activation, ⊣ inhibition, ◇ unknown effect. ← ⊢ point right to left. P, Tx, etc. are path types
